name: Karwendelrast
beschreibung: Karwendelrast is picturesquely nestled at the gateway to the Karwendel Nature Park in Vomp within the Silberregion Karwendel. Surrounded by fragrant forests and alpine pastures, this traditional mountain inn is a favored stopover for hikers, nature enthusiasts, and outdoor groups. In addition to comfortable private and dormitory rooms for mountaineers, the rustic alpine tavern serves hearty Tyrolean fare, game specialties, and homemade desserts. The sunny outdoor beer garden provides tranquil mountain relaxation. The inn serves as a prime trailhead for excursions into the Vomper Kette and the rugged Karwendel range.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine inn and group lodge in Vomp nestled at the base of the Karwendel mountains.
